verdict.rationale: Lago ships its own AI agents (a natural-language billing agent and a Dunning Agent), so asking whether they can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. However, no evidence shows Lago acting as an MCP client or letting users plug in third-party MCP servers. The documented Lago MCP Server is the server role, exposing Lago's billing data to assistants like Claude, so it does not count toward this client-side story.
